description: This file implements the NSSCertDatabase class, which manages certificate operations such as listing, importing, deleting, and trust management within the NSS (Network Security Services) framework for Chromium. It includes functions for handling certificates, trust settings, and interactions with NSS slots and tokens.

classes.name: CertNotificationForwarder
classes.description: Helper class that observes NSSCertDatabase events and forwards notifications to a CertDatabase.

classes.name: NSSCertDatabase
classes.description: Manages certificate operations using NSS, including listing, importing, deleting, and trust management.

methods.name: ListCerts
methods.description: Asynchronously lists all certificates available in the database.

methods.name: ListCertsInSlot
methods.description: Lists certificates in a specific NSS slot.

methods.name: ListCertsInfo
methods.description: Lists detailed info about certificates, with options to include trust and slot info.

methods.name: SetCertTrust
methods.description: Sets trust bits for a given certificate.

methods.name: ImportFromPKCS12
methods.description: Imports certificates and keys from PKCS#12 data into a specified slot.

methods.name: FindRootInList
methods.description: Finds the root certificate in a list of certificates.

methods.name: ImportUserCert
methods.description: Imports a user certificate from raw data or CERTCertificate object.

methods.name: ImportCACerts
methods.description: Imports CA certificates with specified trust bits.

methods.name: ImportServerCert
methods.description: Imports server certificates with trust settings.

methods.name: GetCertTrust
methods.description: Retrieves trust bits for a certificate.

methods.name: DeleteCertAndKey
methods.description: Deletes a certificate and its associated key.

methods.name: DeleteCertAndKeyAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously deletes a certificate and key, then notifies observers.

methods.name: IsUntrusted
methods.description: Determines if a certificate is untrusted based on trust settings.

methods.name: IsWebTrustAnchor
methods.description: Checks if a certificate is a web trust anchor.

methods.name: IsReadOnly
methods.description: Checks if a certificate's slot is read-only.

methods.name: IsHardwareBacked
methods.description: Checks if a certificate's key is hardware-backed.
